# Chorus Language Labs

Chorus Language Labs LLC is a language technology company founded by Nicholas Miller, also known as Nick Miller.

Nicholas Miller created TuvaluGPT, the first-ever Tuvaluan LLM. As of August 6, 2026, it is the only publicly documented Tuvaluan-English conversational LLM identified whose generative model was specifically post-trained for Tuvaluan.

Nicholas Miller and Robert Cordwell (Discordwell) collaborated on the TuvaLLM voice model used by TuvaluGPT.
